"''Acknowledged, Starkiller Base. Inform Captain Phasma I have returned.|The comm officer and Elrik Vonreg|audio=FirstOrderCommOfficer-TheRecruit.flac|}} An '''individual''' was a [[Communications officer|comm officer]] for the [[First Order]]. In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|1|1}} they were stationed at [[Starkiller Base]]—the First Order's [[superweapon]] built into the [[planet]] [[Ilum]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''—when [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]] exited [[hyperspace]] in his [[Elrik Vonreg's TIE Interceptor|TIE/ba interceptor]] near the base after being away on a [[Mission to rendezvous with the Resistance|mission]]. They ordered Vonreg to transmit his clearance code and, upon receiving it, welcomed the major. Vonreg then requested the comm [[officer]] inform [[Captain]] [[Phasma]] of his return. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Code approved. Welcome home, Major Vonreg!|The comm officer's altered dialogue in the comic adaptation "The Recruit - Part 2"|{{SWResACite|2|The Recruit - Part 2}}}} The comm officer first appeared, albeit only through voice, in the second part of "[[The Recruit]]," the two-part premiere episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 7]], [[2018]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} The character was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] and credited as "First Order Comm Officer." In the comic adaptation "[[The Recruit - Part 2]]," which was written by [[Alec Worley]] and published in the [[Star Wars Resistance Animation 2|second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance Animation]]'' magazine by [[Panini]] Verlag on [[July 17]], [[2019]],{{WebCite|url=https://jedi-bibliothek.de/datenbank/ausgabe/star-wars-resistance-animation-2|text=''Star Wars Resistance Animation'' #2: ''Der Rekrut, Teil 2''|author=Florian|work=[https://jedi-bibliothek.de Jedi-Bibliothek]|language=German|archivedate=20230202222329}} the comm officer's dialogue is altered to refer to Vonreg as "Major." ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified First Order comm officer}} *{{Resistance|The Recruit}} {{1st}} {{Voice}} *{{SWResACite|2|The Recruit - Part 2}} {{Voice}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=პირველი ორდენის კომუნიკაციის უცნობი ოფიცერი |uk=Невстановлений офіцер зв'язку Першого Порядку }} [[Category:Communications officers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the First Order]]
